settings.title: Product information
settings.content:
Creatine Monohydrate, Lion's Mane, Siberian Ginseng, Essential Electrolytes, B Vitamins and Biotin. 1.5 flat teaspoons, once a day, in Berry Lemonade.

The most-researched supplement ingredient there is, finally aimed at the right people.

settings.title: Ingredients & nutrition
settings.custom_html:
Ingredients

Creatine Monohydrate, Potassium Chloride, Sodium Chloride, Calcium Chloride, Magnesium Citrate, Acidity Regulators (Citric Acid, Malic Acid), Natural Flavourings, Siberian Ginseng Extract, Lion's Mane Extract, Vitamin C (Calcium Ascorbate), Colouring Food (Red Beetroot Powder), Sweetener (Steviol Glycosides from Stevia), Niacin (Nicotinamide), Pantothenic Acid (Calcium Pantothenate), Vitamin B2 (Riboflavin), Biotin.

Allergens: None. Suitable for vegans.
